request: Reconcile Pinecrest Dental Clinic's April bank statement (~/work/practice/learn-recon-3/statement.csv) against their bank book (~/work/practice/learn-recon-3/ledger.xlsx) and save the reconciliation in that folder in our usual layout.

facts.about: the firm's usual layout for a bank reconciliation, and when a statement line matches a bank-book entry
facts.answer: Our usual layout, for every client: save recon.csv in the same folder as the statement, with the header row date,amount,ledger_ref and then one row per statement line, in the statement's order. Copy date and amount exactly as the statement writes them. ledger_ref is the Voucher of the bank-book entry the line matches, or empty when none matches. A line matches an entry only when the amounts are equal and the description names the entry's party, and each entry matches at most one line.
